content: A DuckDB file has a ~5 MB floor even with one row, and the suite creates a project per test - so pytest's default retention of the last few tmp_path runs left ~2 GB behind per run and filled the disk mid-session. tests/conftest.py's autouse temp_data_dir fixture now shutil.rmtree's the data dir on teardown: 2 GB -> 28 MB per run.
summary: A DuckDB file has a ~5 MB floor even with one row, and the suite creates a project per test...
title: Test suite must delete its DuckDB files, not just its tmp_path
